acceptanceCriteria: Kernel, Release, Runtime and QA pin a versioned pure inventory export with exact owned source paths, explicit input/output schema and digest/provenance binding plus named test contribution permission before implementation.

Valid declared schedules/services produce a deterministic manifest-owned inventory and preview projection including identity, declared lifetime, destination, timezone, missed-run/restart/budget/pause policy and content/config digests; absence of activation approval never becomes enabled or operational status.

Invalid or ambiguous project identity, lifetime, policy, destination ownership or stale digest fails closed or remains explicitly unresolved; unknown/user-edited integrations are preserved rather than claimed, removed or silently normalized.

Pure planning leaves input objects, filesystem, manifest, production DB schema/data, timers, processes and provider/wake state unchanged; no ControlPlane initialization, shell/systemctl invocation or host discovery/activation side effects.

QA approves exact additive boundary scenarios and contributor paths with deterministic declared inputs, fixed clock/timezone where applicable and Test Integrity Note; no existing assertion or snapshot weakening.

Actual implemented export and candidate commit/API contract are handed directly to Release/Runtime; fresh exact source checks, independent QA and serialized guarded integration are required before production consumption, with any schema/engine/tool refusal retained as a blocker rather than fixture promotion.
